title: The Quaint Coral Room | East Nashville + Opryland
description:
🏡 Settle into the Quaint Coral Room in a colorful Craftsman bungalow in East Nashville’s historic Inglewood neighborhood. The home is full of character, with handmade pottery, friendly resident kitties, and a lush wraparound garden that makes it feel like a genuine home away from home.

📍Explore neighborhood restaurants, coffee shops, and bakeries nearby, with easy access to the rest of East Nashville, downtown, BNA, and Nashville’s major attractions.

Two rooms available. Ask for more info.

The space
🏡 MY PROPERTY
Welcome to my 1928 brick Craftsman bungalow in East Nashville’s historic Inglewood neighborhood. I’m a local potter and graphic designer, and I love welcoming people into my home. If you like bungalows, magical cottagecore vibes, pottery, friendly pets, gardens, and a home with personality, you’ll probably feel right at home here.

📍 Inglewood is a convenient Nashville home base, with easy interstate access to Five Points and the rest of East Nashville, downtown and Music City Center, Gaylord Opryland, and TriStar Skyline Medical Center.

🛏️ This listing is for the Quaint Coral Room, a private second-floor bedroom. The upstairs guest bathroom is on the same floor and may be shared with another guest. The upstairs guest area is quiet and separate from the main living spaces downstairs.

🌸 THE CORAL ROOM
The Coral Room was inspired by the pink flowers, flowering shrubs, and Japanese maple just outside. Warm coral tones, teal accents, and charming details give the room its cozy, cottage-inspired personality.

🚪The room includes a comfortable queen bed, hand-selected watercolor feather artwork, and a large window-side desk with plenty of natural light. You'll also have an in-room Keurig, TV, and air-conditioning unit for added comfort.

You’ll have fluffy white towels, extra blankets, and plenty of pillows.

🛋️ THE HOUSE
My home is filled with things I’ve made, collected, and chosen over the years. As a potter and designer, I care about spaces being functional, beautiful, comfortable, and a little unexpected.

You’ll find handmade pottery throughout the house, along with artwork, textiles, plants, books, and collected objects. Many of the dishes and mugs you’ll use were made right here in my pottery studio.

The bungalow extends around the back and upward, with expanded living spaces and a large wraparound garden.

💻 WORKING FROM HOME
I work from home during the day as a PhD student, graphic designer, and potter—and, apparently, as a full-time stay-at-home cat parent.

👋🏻 Because I’m usually around, I can help when needed while giving you as much privacy and independence as you prefer. Some guests enjoy talking over coffee; others come and go on their own. Both are completely welcome.

🐾 THE PETS
I’m an avid animal rescuer and advocate, and several rescue cats call the house home, as well as my service dog, Onyx.

They’re friendly, affectionate, and very much part of the personality of the house. Please keep the pets out of the upstairs guest area—and don't let the cats outside (they lie!).

⚠️ Note: One particularly determined tabby occasionally disagrees with this policy, so keeping the upstairs door closed is the best defense.

❤️ HOSTING
I've hosted over a thousand wonderful people from all over the US and internationally and genuinely enjoy helping guests feel at home and enjoy Nashville.

🫶🏻 Everyone is welcome in my home regardless of faith, heritage, identity, or orientation.

I’m happy to offer recommendations or help when needed while respecting your privacy. The household tends to settle down early, so I simply ask guests returning late to be considerate of the quiet house.

☕ IN THE MORNING
Come downstairs, make some coffee, choose a handmade ceramic mug, and enjoy the garden or settle into one of the shared spaces.

This is a real home—full of pottery, cats, plants, color, and things made by hand—and I hope it feels like one while you’re here.

Guest access
☕ COFFEE + WATER
Your room includes a Keurig, filtered water, and a small refrigerator. Coffee is provided, and you’re welcome to bring your own K-Cups if you prefer.

🚰 Filtered water can be refilled from the small bronze faucet in the kitchen using the home’s 8-stage reverse-osmosis system.

🧴 TOWELS + TOILETRIES
Fresh towels, shampoo, and basic toiletries are provided. If you need anything additional during your stay, just ask.

🚿 UPSTAIRS BATHROOM
The guest bathroom is upstairs on the same floor as the Yellow Room, but it is not attached to the bedroom. It may be shared with another upstairs guest. The downstairs bathroom is private.

🍳 KITCHEN USE
Short-term guests generally have what they need with the in-room coffee setup, filtered water, and refrigerator. For longer stays, we can discuss additional kitchen use.

🌿 PATIO + GARDEN
You’re welcome to enjoy the patio and wraparound garden—a great spot for morning coffee, reading, or relaxing outside.

During your stay
💬 DURING YOUR STAY
I work from home, so I’m often available for questions, local recommendations, or anything you need during your stay.

I’m a graphic designer, PhD student, baker, and local potter, so you’ll usually find me working from my home office, in the garden, or making pottery.

I’m happy to chat when I’m free, but I also respect guests who prefer more privacy and independence.

Other things to note
🛏️ TRAVELING WITH FRIENDS?
This listing accommodates up to 2 guests. If you're traveling with 3–4 people, consider booking our other upstairs bedroom as well, or check out our Whole Upstairs listing, which includes both bedrooms and a bathroom exclusively for your group.

🚶 WALK THE NEIGHBORHOOD
The house is in a very walkable pocket of Inglewood, with plenty of food, drinks, shops, and everyday essentials nearby.

🍽️ RESTAURANTS + CASUAL DINING
• Neighborhood pub food + burgers (ML Rose, Roy’s Tavern)
• Mexican (El Fuego, Las Fiestas)
• Mediterranean (Nick the Greek)
• Pizza (Roma Pizza, Little Caesars)
• Quick bites (Sonic)

☕ COFFEE + TREATS
• Coffee + desserts (Sip Café)
• Handmade chocolates (Colts Chocolates)
• Bagels (Crieve Hall Bagel Co.)

🛍️ SHOPPING + LOCAL FINDS
• Antiques + vintage finds (East Nashville Antiques)
• Grocery (Kroger)
• Pharmacy (Walgreens)
• Wine + liquor (Sinkers)
• Post office, gas station, and convenience stores nearby
• Shopping mall (Opry Mills, a short drive away)

🗺️ EXPLORE EAST NASHVILLE
Five Points and the rest of East Nashville are an easy drive or rideshare away, with even more restaurants, coffee shops, pubs, bars, casual and fine dining, music venues, art, shops, and Jeni’s Ice Cream.

🚗 GETTING AROUND
The house has easy interstate access and is typically about 10–15 minutes by car from many of Nashville’s major destinations, including Five Points and East Nashville, downtown and Music City Center, Gaylord Opryland and Opry Mills, TriStar Skyline Medical Center, and Nashville International Airport (BNA), depending on traffic.

🚌 PUBLIC TRANSIT
I'm also near WeGo Route 56, with service along Gallatin Pike toward Nissan Stadium and downtown. Public transit is available nearby, though most guests find a car, Lyft, or Uber easiest for exploring Nashville.

💬 LOCAL RECOMMENDATIONS
I’m always happy to share recommendations based on what you’re looking for while you’re here.
